svg.title: arduino_arm: breadboard view
svg.desc: Generated by Text to Robot from the robot's wiring record (design.wiring). Each wire carries data-wire, its colour is the wire colour in WIRING.md.
svg.text: Every wire of WIRING.md, in its colour, from pin to pin. Grey bundles are bought leads (USB, camera ribbon).
IEC C14 panel inlet with fuse drawer and rocker switch

W3 MAINS_E: mains_inlet.load.E to power_supply.ac_in.FG, 24 AWG

W17 GND: controller.power_jack.GND to servo_driver.control_in.GND, 24 AWG

W19 I2C_SCL: controller.janalog.A5/SCL to servo_driver.control_in.SCL, 26 AWG

W12 GND: servo_driver.ch2.GND to elbow_servo.servo_lead.GND (brown), 24 AWG
W22 GND: power_supply.dc_out.DC OUTPUT -V to servo_driver.v_plus.GND, 20 AWG
W20 V_SERVO: power_supply.dc_out.DC OUTPUT +V to main_switch.contacts.IN, 20 AWG
W13 SERVO3_PWM: servo_driver.ch3.PWM3 to claw_servo.servo_lead.Signal (yellow), 26 AWG
